summary: The Worksheet file is part of a complex system for managing educational resources and scheduling. It involves filtering and managing data related to courses, instructors, departments, and programs. Various dropdown filters are utilized to customize and refine the data displayed within the worksheet.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing educational scheduling and data filtering involving elements such as courses, departments, cohorts, terms, and instructors.

fields.name: ddInstructorFilter
fields.functionality: Select instructor based on session data.

fields.name: ddDateFilter
fields.functionality: Filter by date based on session data.

fields.name: ddCampusFilter
fields.functionality: Select campus based on session data.

fields.name: ddSectionFilter
fields.functionality: Select section based on session data.

fields.name: ddCFOFilter
fields.functionality: Select CFO mode based on session data.

workflows.name: Worksheet Management and Filtering
steps: Select values in dropdown filters based on session variables.
Load CFO dropdown and handle visibility conditions.
Clear session variables and switch to view state.
Fill dropdowns with data sources for filtering.

business_rules: Ensure selected instructors are different for courses.
validations: Validate that start and end dates are correct and fall within allowed ranges.
Ensure reply dates are before start dates.
conditions: Visibility of CFO filter based on program flags.
system_behavior: Use of JavaScript for client-side validation and interaction.
dependencies: Session management for storing and retrieving filter states.
Database access for retrieving dropdown data.
exceptions: Invalid date range handling and error messaging.
